source: play.usaultimate.org club team roster pages (2026 season), supplied by the user as screenshots. Missing jersey numbers were filled from the matching UFA club roster on watchufa.com (Wind Chill, Flyers, Breeze, Phoenix, Hustle, Sol, Glory, Union) and, where UFA had no entry or the number was already taken, generated.
note: Real per-player names, jersey, position, height and stats. Stat columns map: source 'Points' = goals, 'Assists' = assists, 'Ds' = blocks, 'Turns' = turnovers. Games played is NOT published by USAU, unlike the EUCS source - the loader must estimate it. Six teams (pacmen, chain-lightning, doublewide, red-tide, rdu, haymaker) publish no stats at all and carry hasStats:false; their players should be profiled from position + height only. Heights are raw imperial strings; physically impossible values in the source (2'3", 3'11", 9'3", 10'11" etc.) were dropped to null rather than guessed. jerseySource marks where a number came from: 'club' = on the source roster, 'ufa' = taken from the player's UFA team, 'generated' = assigned by us.
crossRosterConflicts: Four players appear on two different club rosters: Pawel Janas (assigned to DiG per user, removed from Chicago Machine), Ryan duSaire (Chicago Machine #6 and Sub Zero #10), Alexander Davis (PoNY #80 and Ring of Fire #80), Brian Trowbridge (Haymaker #61 and Ring of Fire #25). Only Janas is resolved; the other three are still duplicated below and must be de-duplicated before import.
openQuestion: DiG: the user asked for sebastian rossi = 8, but 8 belongs to Thomas Edmonds on both the club roster and Boston Glory. rossi is parked on 10 pending a decision.
